visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman wearing a black Gryffindor wizard robe with red lining stands before a deep blue storefront labeled "Harry Potter Mahou Dokoro." She gestures excitedly toward the entrance and walks into a store characterized by polished wood floors and antique-style cabinetry under bright indoor spotlights. (2) The scene cuts to an exterior wide shot of the Nangang LaLaport shopping mall entrance with clear glass doors and pedestrians moving in the background. The lighting is natural daylight mixed with shadows from the surrounding urban structures and mall architecture. (3) Inside the store, the woman explores wooden shelves stocked with Harry Potter merchandise, including scarves and books. She poses near a brick wall with a "9 3/4 Platform" sign, holding a wand and pushing a luggage trolley with bird cages. (4) Detailed close-up shots showcase a life-sized Dobby the house-elf statue and various wands in green and black packaging. A hand demonstrates a chocolate frog music box opening to reveal a gold frog inside, surrounded by blue and gold patterned box panels. (5) The woman displays jewelry such as a rotating Time-Turner necklace and a Hedwig owl music box. The environment features warm, yellow indoor lighting and specific themed decorations like hanging Hogwarts acceptance letters and house banners from the ceiling. (6) Information graphics regarding reservation methods are displayed over a view of the store's exterior queuing area. The video concludes with the woman waving in a shop aisle, followed by a graphic screen showing social media icons and website links.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy, orchestral fantasy music with a fast tempo of approximately 135 BPM begins. A friendly, high-pitched female narrator introduces the shop with significant vocal arousal and clear articulation. The acoustic environment has a subtle indoor room tone with very light background chatter from the retail floor. (2) A distinct electronic "whoosh" transition sound effect marks a visual shift to the exterior. The narration continues at a fast pace, detailing the store's location at Nangang LaLaport. The background music maintains its upbeat, major-mode tonality with prominent string and brass instrument textures. (3) A magical, high-frequency "sparkle" or chime sound effect triggers as merchandise wands are showcased. The narrator's pitch variability increases to express excitement while describing the wands. The spectral brightness of the track is high, emphasizing the sharp transients of these added post-production sound effects. (4) A short, mechanical percussive "clack" occurs as a music box is opened, followed by a brief melodic jingle from the box itself. The primary background music swells slightly in volume, competing with the narration which now focuses on specific promotional details, limited edition gifts, and reservation steps.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Location Intro -> Product Showcase -> Photo Spot Feature -> Booking Instructions -> Limited Offers -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the opening of the first overseas Harry Potter Mahou Dokoro retail store at Nangang LaLaport Taipei, showcasing exclusive merchandise, interactive products, and photo spots to drive foot traffic and online bookings.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Detailed showcasing of products with price tags, store location mention, and explicit calls to follow social media and visit the shop.
